note: Every PNG written by tools/extract_pokemon.py. Shade convention: 2-bit indexed PNG, palette index = shade (0 white, 1 light grey 170, 2 dark grey 85, 3 black); decode with shade = 3 - (r >> 6). No transparency chunk: overworld-style OBJ use treats shade 0 as transparent at draw time. tilesPerRow/tiles describe 8x8 tiles in row-major order unless tileOrder says otherwise. "tilemap" arrays are the raw tile ids of the .tilemap file.

picTilemaps.note: Tilemaps used to place pics (data/tilemaps.asm, CopyDownscaledMonTiles). A 7x7 pic is stored in VRAM column-major: pic tile n is column n // 7, row n % 7 - so "front" (tile ids 0..48, rows listed left to right) is the identity layout. picCells gives [column, row] of the 7x7 pic for every entry. downscaled_3x3 / downscaled_5x5 hold absolute ids for a pic whose first tile is $31 (CopyTileIDs adds hBaseTileID); AnimateSendingOutMon shows the 3x3 then the 5x5 sampling before the full pic (send-out "grow"). slide_down_7x5 / 7x3 drop pic rows while a fainted mon slides down (TILEMAP_SLIDE_DOWN_MON_PIC_*).
